adjudication.rationale: In `packages/emails/templates/organizer-add-guests-email.ts`, the subject interpolates `this.calEvent.attendees[0].name` with no guard. While the shown `addGuests.handler.ts` path constructs `evt.attendees` from the updated booking attendees (and enforces `uniqueGuests.length > 0`, making an empty attendees list unlikely in this flow), the email template itself assumes a non-empty attendees array and would throw if `sendAddGuestsEmails` were ever called with a `calEvent` lacking attendees (e.g., future callers or unexpected data). This is a concrete edge-case risk tied to the new code, but not a provably-triggered defect from the diff alone.
